critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single solid grey fuselage block with an array of 15-20 small, individual rectangular planes. Each plane should have a width of 0.4 units and a height of 0.8 units, spaced 0.1 units apart along the longitudinal axis of the fuselage side to create a continuous window line.

discrepancies.observed: A single solid grey block along the fuselage side
discrepancies.reference: A continuous horizontal line of small individual rectangular windows

discrepancies.observed: A large, singular dark grey block at the nose
discrepancies.reference: A distinct cluster of 4-6 individual panes arranged in a wrap-around shape
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: subdivide into smaller planes with gaps

discrepancies.observed: No visible break or seam for the primary boarding door
discrepancies.reference: A clear vertical rectangular outline near the front of the fuselage
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add a thin, slightly recessed plane to define the door frame

discrepancies.observed: Smooth continuous fuselage surface above the wing
discrepancies.reference: Small distinct rectangular outlines for emergency exits over the wing section
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add small rectangular planes on top of the fuselage
